title: 六輪のパッド付きメカニッククリーパー
description: 整備ガレージで車体の下に寝て移動する姿を表す低床クリーパー。丸い鋼管フレーム、長いクッション、独立した高いヘッドレスト、縁取りと縫い目表現、持ち手、裏面の横梁と取付部、六つの旋回キャスターを備えます。人物、車両、工具は含みません。静的な外観素材で、走行・荷重支持・安全性を検証した製品ではなく、製作・使用・安全の指示や認証を提供しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.537 × 0.219 × 1.123 m、20,020三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A low rolling mechanics board for under-vehicle workshop scenes, with a rounded tubular frame, long padded cushion, separate raised headrest, welt and seam details, carry handle, underside crossmembers and mount hardware, and six complete swivel-caster assemblies. Person, vehicle and tools are not included. This is static appearance geometry, not a tested rolling, load-bearing or safety-rated product; no engineering, operation or safety instructions or certification are supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.537 × 0.219 × 1.123 m; 20,020 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
